THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FANTASY & PERIOD
071
STUDY 134
Burgundy Lace Corset & Boots
Rights check
Source: 25020.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair sits
on a dark wooden chest against a deep teal backdrop.
She wears a burgundy lace cardigan over a burgundy
corset bodice with a plunging neckline and lace trim. A
pendant on a fine chain rests at her chest. Dark
trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the look.
Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, low-key studio
light with gentle falloff. Palette of burgundy, deep teal,
and warm brown. Dark romantic and editorial, in the
style of a fine-art portrait.
Dark romantic, moody, editorial
WORKING NOTES
- The lace cardigan over the corset is the defining layer.
- Keep the teal backdrop for a rich, moody contrast.
